objective: maximize ExpectedEarnedInformationGain per token: Spawn(G_i) iff E[dN_earned | G_i] / Cost(G_i) > lambda. V0 is RULE-BASED (heuristic priors); receipts accumulate training data for FABLE_V1 empirical calibration. The authority model does NOT change between V0 and V1.
gate_signals_source: derived from the A+B scout packets ONLY (scouts run first; gate is a pure function of their reported signals).
need_more_budget_rule: A role that exhausts its budget returns STATUS=TRUNCATED + NeedMoreBudget{reason}. It is NON-AUTHORITATIVE and is NOT auto-rescued. TRUNCATED != scored 0 (NOT_EVALUABLE != 0).
hard_boundary: Gamma_C != Gamma_A. This scheduler optimizes (k, roles, budgets, stopping). It MUST NOT optimize, relax, or simulate Gamma_A admission. Pipeline STOPS at CANDIDATE.
